dalamud.name: Dalamud
dalamud.note: Plugin framework for FFXIV client tools and mods. Install this first, everything else on this page runs through it

penumbra.name: Penumbra
penumbra.note: Runtime mod loader, applies texture/model mods without touching game files. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

glamourer.name: Glamourer
glamourer.note: Changes your character's outside appearance using Penumbra mods, what Glamaholic plates apply through. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

the reni guide.name: The Reni Guide
the reni guide.note: Beginner-friendly walkthrough for setting up Penumbra and Glamourer to mod your character's appearance

burning down the house (bdth).name: Burning Down The House (BDTH)
burning down the house (bdth).note: Gizmo-based housing item positioning, far more precise than the in-game editor. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory.

lifestream.name: Lifestream
lifestream.note: Travel to another world, data center, or house with a single command. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

glamaholic.name: Glamaholic
glamaholic.note: Save and swap glamour plates. Import looks straight from Eorzea Collection or someone else's export, try them on, and apply via Glamourer. In the default plugin repo

xiv mod archive.name: XIV Mod Archive
xiv mod archive.note: Biggest free mod repository: glamour, gear, and animation mods, installed via Penumbra

heliosphere.name: Heliosphere
heliosphere.note: Second mod source/manager I check when Mod Archive doesn't have what I'm looking for

glamour dresser.name: Glamour Dresser
glamour dresser.note: Paid mod marketplace. I don't usually pay, but a lot of creators unpaywall mods after a while, so I browse their Patreons for stuff that's gone free

compress yourself.name: Compress Yourself
compress yourself.note: Step-by-step guide to compressing mod textures for Lightless/PlayerSync. Keeps synced mod sizes down

chat 2.name: Chat 2
chat 2.note: Complete in-game chat window rewrite: unlimited tabs, better filtering, RGB channel colors, unread counts. A must-have

umbra xiv.name: Umbra XIV
umbra xiv.note: Fully customizable toolbars and 3D world markers. In the default plugin repo

better friend list.name: Better Friend List
better friend list.note: Cross-server friend list with FC-style login/logout notifications. The other person needs it installed too for you to see theirs

allagan tools.name: Allagan Tools
allagan tools.note: Cross-storage inventory search and filtering across characters, retainers, and the Free Company chest, plus craft planning and marketboard integration right in tooltips. In the default plugin repo

allagan market.name: Allagan Market
allagan market.note: Tracks retainer market listings, sales, and undercutting across every character at once. In the default plugin repo

price insight.name: Price Insight
price insight.note: Shows NQ/HQ marketboard prices and the most recent sale directly on an item's tooltip on hover, pulled from Universalis. In the default plugin repo

stacksellprice.name: StackSellPrice
stacksellprice.note: Shows a full stack's vendor sell price on the tooltip instead of just one unit, so you don't have to do the multiplication yourself before deciding to vendor a pile of materials. In the default plugin repo

repairme.name: RepairMe
repairme.note: Reminds you when gear needs repairing or still has materia to extract before you get rid of it. In the default plugin repo

simple tweaks.name: Simple Tweaks
simple tweaks.note: Huge, individually toggleable grab-bag of quality-of-life tweaks; several touch inventory, retainers, and tooltips directly. In the default plugin repo

dalamud plugin browser.name: Dalamud Plugin Browser
dalamud plugin browser.note: Better search/browse UI for what's available in the main plugin repo than Dalamud's own in-game list

puni.sh.name: Puni.sh
puni.sh.note: Plugin studio/publisher I pull from a lot: Artisan, AutoRetainer, Pandora's Box, and more. Their repo goes under Dalamud's Experimental settings.
